title: Apartment Building Addis
subtitle: Contemporary Multi-Family Urban Living
description: A refined modern residential building designed for dense urban living in Addis Ababa. Featuring sculpted recessed balconies, charcoal steel brise-soleil screening, and lush integrated planter boxes that bring private greenery into every unit. Day and evening lighting schemes highlight the clean rectilinear white volumes.

title: Asnakech Luxury Residence & Apartments
subtitle: Bespoke Multi-Level Living & Sky Terrace
description: An intimate residential enclave combining ground-floor secure garage and garden entry with grand open-concept family suites and an expansive rooftop pergola entertainment terrace. Complete interior architecture showcases Italian minimalist furniture, ambient ceiling troughs, and floor-to-ceiling glass fenestrations.
keyFeatures: Master suite with bespoke wardrobe system

title: Juba Mall & Luxury Apartments
subtitle: Twin High-Rise Towers & Atrium Galleria
scope: Masterplanning, Architectural Design, Interior Mall Design
description: A landmark civic and commercial destination in the heart of Juba. The complex features two 10-story high-rise towers for luxury residences and corporate penthouses flanking a four-story central skylight atrium shopping galleria with escalators, retail boutiques, dining concourses, and palm-lined pedestrian boulevards.
keyFeatures: Twin high-rise towers with panoramic balconies

title: Juba Mixed-Use Commercial Complex
subtitle: Urban Commercial Podium & Luxury Residences
description: Currently under construction in Juba, this dynamic commercial center integrates premium ground-floor retail, banking halls, and flexible corporate office space with luxury residential units on upper levels. The reflective tinted curtain wall delivers high solar shading performance in the equatorial climate.

title: Sevita Real Estate Tower
subtitle: 22-Story Commercial & Residential Skyscraper
location: Bole Road, Alem Building, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Standing on prime Bole Road, the Sevita Tower is an iconic glass-and-steel skyscraper engineered to define the Addis Ababa skyline. The tower incorporates a bustling street-level restaurant terrace, luxury retail shopping podium, Grade-A corporate offices, and serviced residential apartments crowned by an illuminated sky crown.
keyFeatures: Integrated solar louvers and LED facade illumination

title: Hayat Association Apartment Project
subtitle: Community-Centric Urban Housing & Retail Arcade
description: Designed for the vibrant Hayat neighborhood, this project fuses middle-density family housing with an active ground-floor commercial galleria including supermarket, specialty coffee house, and secure residential lobby with outdoor piazza seating.
keyFeatures: Ground floor market & coffee shop arcade

title: Ministry of Defense Apartment Complex
subtitle: Curvilinear Multi-Tower Officers Complex
description: Commissioned for the 6 Kilo district, this twin-tower complex provides secure, dignified housing for defense personnel. Distinctive aerodynamic curved roof forms capture breezes and channel rainwater, connected by high-level communal pedestrian sky bridges.

title: Luxury Residence for Hagbes Family
subtitle: Cantilevered Modernist Estate with Lap Pool
description: A modernist private residence in the prestigious Bisrate Gebriel neighborhood. The architecture is defined by dramatic interlocking white cantilevered volumes, floor-to-ceiling glass pavilions, warm timber soffits, an illuminated swimming pool, and terraced landscaped gardens.
keyFeatures: Cantilevered upper volume framing pool view
Integrated outdoor lounge & sunken pool terrace
Warm natural teak wood ceiling soffits
Smart home climate and security integration

title: Erbil Mixed-Use Commercial Tower
subtitle: 24-Story High-Rise with Vertical Gardens
description: An international commission in Erbil, this slender 24-story tower integrates regional headquarters offices with luxury serviced apartments. Stepped green balconies climb the building facade, providing micro-climate cooling and dramatic night-time facade illumination along Erbil's main artery.
keyFeatures: High thermal mass cladding for desert climate

title: Sarbet Mixed-Use Landmark Tower
subtitle: Commercial Retail Podium & High-Rise Apartments
description: Situated in the bustling diplomatic enclave of Sarbet, this 16-story tower combines an imposing natural stone commercial podium housing an international bank branch and gourmet supermarket with modern residential apartments and a scenic glass-enclosed rooftop lounge.
keyFeatures: Limestone and granite clad commercial podium

title: Kokeb Tower & Hospitality Expansion
subtitle: 26-Story Tower & Fine Dining Restaurant Interior
description: An ambitious expansion of the landmark Kokeb complex, adding a soaring 26-story mixed-use tower. The project includes world-class interior architecture for a flagship fine-dining restaurant featuring parametric acoustic wall panels, integrated warm linear LED lighting, and outdoor pergola terraces.
keyFeatures: Slender high-rise profile with distinctive vertical finning
Bespoke hospitality seating & private dining suites

title: Hagbes Showroom & Machinery Sales Center
subtitle: Aerodynamic Aerofoil Glass Pavilion
scope: Architectural Design, Structural Steel & Site Planning
description: An architectural tour de force along the Addis-Adama industrial highway in Gelan. Designed for heavy machinery, agriculture equipment, and automotive sales, the pavilion features a monumental sweeping curved roof reminiscent of an airplane wing, enclosing a 16-meter column-free glass showroom concourse.
keyFeatures: Outdoor tractor and excavator display boulevard

title: Wachamo University Research Campus
subtitle: Colonnaded Agriculture Lab & Postgraduate Center
description: A major expansion of Wachamo University in Hosanna, comprising a classical colonnaded Agricultural Laboratory with a central biophilic lightwell, a 6-story Postgraduate Academic Facility with outdoor access stair towers, and a specialized Poultry Research Laboratory.
keyFeatures: Central lightwell atrium for natural ventilation
Specialized wet and dry research laboratories
External egress stairs with graphic architectural articulation

title: Bensa Coffee Pulping & Processing Plant
subtitle: Agro-Industrial Eco-Facility in Sidama
description: Nestled in the highlands of world-renowned coffee terroir Sidama, this facility harmonizes heavy agro-industrial processing with ecological sustainability. Includes pulping stations, tiered sun drying beds, washing canals, and biological water treatment sedimentation ponds.
keyFeatures: Heavy truck logistics and weighing infrastructure

title: Juba Central Fire Brigade Station
subtitle: Emergency Response & Civic Dispatch Command
description: The primary emergency fire and rescue hub for Juba, engineered for sub-minute dispatch times. Features a high-bay red structural steel spaceframe canopy housing heavy fire apparatus, observation drill towers, crew living dormitories, and rapid egress slipways.

title: ADRA NGO Regional Headquarters
subtitle: Corporate Office Pavilion & Executive Suites
description: Regional headquarters for the global humanitarian agency ADRA in Juba. The building pairs an elegant glass facade with horizontal solar brise-soleil shading, accompanied by rich executive interior suites featuring black marble paneling, leather boardroom furnishings, and energy-efficient lighting.

title: Hagbes Regional Headquarters & Kality Hub
subtitle: Corporate Office Expansion & Flagship Interior Fitout
description: A comprehensive corporate headquarters expansion representing premier industrial brands Hitachi, Daewoo, and Higer. Includes an illuminated 12-meter continuous reception counter, double-height naturally lit atrium galleries, ergonomic open-plan workstations, and heavy freight loading docks.
keyFeatures: Acoustic timber slat ceilings and linear LED lights
Heavy transport loading dock & logistics yard

title: GPOC Petrol VIP Residences & Modular Camp
subtitle: Oil Field Accommodation & Pre-Engineered Compound
location: Wizeen Camp / Unity State, South Sudan
scope: Modular Prefab Design, Turnkey Camp Construction
description: Constructed in challenging remote conditions in South Sudan, this complex provides high-comfort accommodation for petroleum executives and technical staff. Consists of 2-story serviced VIP apartment blocks, stilt-mounted insulated prefab living quarters, central dining, sports, and healthcare facilities.
keyFeatures: Central community recreation and dining pavilions

title: Arsi University College of Agriculture Campus
subtitle: 80-Hectare Comprehensive University Masterplan
description: A transformative campus masterplan spanning 80 hectares in Assela. The comprehensive scheme unifies academic lecture theaters, agronomy laboratories, faculty offices, student dormitories, experimental farms, and central civic plazas into a cohesive pedestrian-oriented university town.

title: Gambella University College of Health Compound
subtitle: Medical Campus & Olympic Stadium Masterplan
description: A premier regional higher-education medical hub in Gambella. Featuring state-of-the-art medical classrooms, teaching clinics, a regulation Olympic track and field athletic stadium with spectator grandstands, student housing villages, and tropical shaded canopy walkways.

title: PHCC General Hospital Complex
subtitle: Emergency Medical Center & Clinical Inpatient Facility
description: A vital regional hospital in Juba designed to international healthcare standards. Features a grand arched drop-off portico for ambulances, modern reception and triage zones, sterile pathology testing laboratories, and bright 24-bed acute inpatient wards with direct garden courtyard views.
keyFeatures: Inpatient recovery wards with green views
Independent backup solar and medical oxygen plants

title: Torhailoch Golf Club Luxury Estate
subtitle: Modernist Fairway Villa with Infinity Dining Deck
location: Torhailoch Golf Club, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Fronting the greens of the Torhailoch Golf Club, this estate exemplifies minimalist luxury living. The design features expansive outdoor dining decks with night-lit swimming pools, full-height sliding glass pocket doors, and master suites looking out over private manicured fairways.
keyFeatures: Outdoor alfresco dining pavilion & sun terrace
Master suite with bespoke walk-in dressing lounge

title: Bishoftu Hora Lake Dining & Leisure Pavilion
subtitle: Terraced Hillside Lakeside Hospitality
description: Cascading down the volcanic caldera slopes of scenic Lake Hora in Bishoftu. The multi-tiered restaurant features expansive umbrella-shaded dining decks, an open-air amphitheater garden with sculptural seating benches, and vehicular parking seamlessly woven into dense tropical landscaping.
keyFeatures: Lakeside arrival promenade and tree-canopied parking

title: Assela Referral Hospital Biophilic Cafe
subtitle: MCH Teaching Hospital Communal Pavilion
description: An inviting social respite for doctors, patients, and families at the Assela Referral Hospital. The biophilic two-story glass pavilion incorporates hanging garden trellis planters, open-air rooftop coffee lounge, and pedestrian crosswalk access.
keyFeatures: Biophilic vertical green walls and hanging planters
Direct accessibility to hospital main concourse

title: Evergreen 2,000-Hectare Farm & Avocado Oil Plant
subtitle: Mega Agro-Industrial Estate & Cold-Press Factory
description: One of the most expansive private agro-industrial developments in the Horn of Africa. Masterplan spans 2,000 hectares of precision-irrigated avocado orchards, an autonomous 'Minimum Viable City' community for workers, and an industrial cold-press avocado oil processing factory.
keyFeatures: Logistics highway connection and cold-chain staging

title: Kingdon Salt Processing Factory
subtitle: Industrial Salt Refinery & Logistics Terminal
description: Positioned in the mineral-rich Afar salt flats near Lake Afedera. The facility is engineered for harsh desert conditions, comprising heavy truck intake scales, a 200-meter automated refining and iodization warehouse, administrative offices, and high-volume freight logistics dispatch.
keyFeatures: Heavy freight truck scale and staging loop
Autonomous power generation and water desalinization

title: Gafat Armament Engineering Defense Complex
subtitle: Ministry of Defense Masterplan & Helipad Facility
description: A high-security defense engineering installation in Bishoftu. The masterplan integrates secure engineering research pavilions, an executive rooftop helipad, an outdoor sports arena with terraced seating, and dense forest security buffers.
keyFeatures: Natural forest eco-buffer and access control

title: King Nejashi Islamic Center & Monumental Arch Tower
subtitle: Monumental Grand Mosque & 45-Story Arch Skyscraper
location: Bulgaria / AU Area, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: An epochal cultural and architectural landmark for the African continent, situated near the African Union Headquarters in Addis Ababa. The project unites an awe-inspiring 45-story Arch Skyscraper featuring a soaring central Islamic arch void lined with intricate golden geometric mashrabiya filigree, alongside a grand congregational mosque with four towering 75-meter minarets, cultural conference center, and sweeping civic prayer plazas.
keyFeatures: Iconic 45-story Arch Skyscraper with monumental arch void
Grand congregational mosque with four 75m minarets

title: Bethelem Academy Comprehensive Campus
subtitle: K-12 Educational Compound & Olympic Athletics Track
description: A progressive educational campus designed around a bold V-shaped academic building featuring vibrant polychromatic solar louvers. The grounds incorporate an Olympic running track, soccer pitch, tennis and basketball courts, early learning daycare facilities, and landscaped study courtyards.
keyFeatures: Iconic V-shaped academic wing with rainbow louvers
Full regulation running track & soccer stadium
Internal tree-canopied play and assembly courtyards

title: Anne Academy & Daycare Facility
subtitle: Early Childhood Learning Center & Play Courtyard
description: A completed early childhood and primary learning academy in Bishoftu. The architecture utilizes colorful educational alphabet murals, secure exterior circulation towers, sheltered playground courtyards, and child-scaled learning environments.

title: Villa Neoclassique Bishoftu
subtitle: 4-Story Classical Residence & Rooftop Pergola
description: A stately residence reflecting neoclassical symmetry fused with modern luxury. Features grand double-height Corinthian entrance columns, arched French balconies with wrought-iron railings, stone balustrades, and a rooftop pergola lounge.
keyFeatures: Arched French balconies with decorative balustrades

title: Arbaminch Highway Motel & Fueling Station
subtitle: Integrated Southern Rift Roadside Travel Hub
description: Strategically positioned along the main transportation artery into Arbaminch and the Southern Rift Valley. The complex combines a multi-story guest motel, retail convenience center, high-clearance vehicle canopy fuel station, and heavy transport staging yards.
keyFeatures: High-capacity fuel canopy for passenger and freight vehicles
Spacious highway turning radius and parking lots

title: Noora Cliffside Lake Resort
subtitle: Volcanic Basalt Bluff Hospitality & Finishing Design
description: A daring feat of cliffside engineering perched atop the sheer volcanic basalt crags overlooking Bishoftu's crater lake. The design features stepped timber suites, thatched pavilion roofs celebrating Ethiopian vernacular craft, and cantilevered glass observation walkways suspended over the abyss.

title: Gondar Heritage G+10 Hotel
subtitle: Curvilinear High-Rise Hotel at Urban Intersection
description: Located at a prominent three-way boulevard intersection in the historic imperial city of Gondar. The 10-story hotel features an aerodynamic curvilinear corner facade, rhythmic vertical solar shading louvers, ground floor retail, and a top-floor sky lounge commanding views across the city.
